audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A female voice speaks in Simplified Chinese with a playful, teasing tone and moderate pitch, delivered at a conversational loudness. The acoustic background is quiet, featuring only a very subtle indoor room tone floor without any music. (2) A mechanical click sound signals the mounting of the motorcycle, followed immediately by the mid-frequency rumble of the engine starting. A moderate-tempo electronic dance track with a heavy synth bass and steady electronic percussion begins to play under the vocals. (3) The female voice returns with a rhythmic phrase as the motorcycle engine idles steadily in the background mix. The electronic BGM maintains its energy and volume, creating a balanced interplay between the spoken voice, the mechanical engine transients, and the synth textures. The recording is clear and professionally mixed with no distortion.
